messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up: FinTrust just escalated. They're due on CAIQ/SIG in ~72h and flagged missing audit logs + KMS/HSM attestation. Also reporting intermittent API 401s and a weird billing spike. Details below.
Jamal Ortiz: Can you paste the request_id and a couple sample timestamps? We'll correlate with audit logs and token-service traces.
Maria Chen: Request id and sample repro: ```curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-mini\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'``` Response we got: ```HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token", "request_id":"r-20260315-FT-7c9a"}``` Happened around 2026-03-15T14:02:31Z and 14:04:12Z. Customer ticket FT-9876 has their bespoke CAIQ they've attached.
Sean Blake: Looks like token validation returned 401s from 14:01:50Z -> 14:05:00Z. Correlating with infra — there was a token-service deploy at 14:01:50Z. Also note: KMS key id ft-prod-01 last rotation 2026-03-01. Need to check HSM access logs and rotation certs. :thinking:
Jamal Ortiz: On it. Maria, can you also share the CAIQ PDF and the exact S3 path they want the export to? We'll need retention window and the evidence package requirements.
Maria Chen: Attached in the ticket: they want 24 months retention; export to s3://fintrust-evidence/2026/03 and they specifically asked for HSM usage logs + rotation certs + audit manifests. They also want a brief RCA for the 401s and the billing spike.
Anya Patel: :raised_hands: I asked them for a deadline extension — they tentatively gave us 3 business days. I'll try for an extra week but wanted to know if eng can produce signed attestation + the export this afternoon.
Sean Blake: We can produce signed attestations. I'll kick off the audit export job with encryption and manifest signing. Command I'm running: ```/opt/redwood/bin/audit-export --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-03-15 --bucket fintrust-evidence --encrypt --sign-manifest``` Will attach signed SHA256 and manifest after.
Jamal Ortiz: Quick find: the token-service deploy at 2026-03-15T14:01:50Z missed a config flag (token.ttl override set to 0 in staging override). That would cause immediate token invalidation -> 401 bursts. Rolling back to previous config now and starting deeper trace. This likely explains the auth failures and the anomalous billing (retries).
redwood-deploy-bot: Deployment rollback started for service token-service by Jamal Ortiz — run id deploy-20260315-78ef — ETA ~2m.
Maria Chen: Customer asked for a single bundle: CAIQ answers, audit-export link, HSM attestation (signed), and a short RCAs blurb covering 401s + billing spike. I'll assemble and send once I have links. Please ping me when export + attestation are ready. :eyes:
Jamal Ortiz: Export complete and uploaded (internal): https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/fintrust-evidence/2026/03/export-FT-9876.tar.gz  SHA256: abc123def4567890... Postmortem draft saved at /docs/incidents/ft-401-billing-spike.md, will share a redacted copy for the customer bundle.
Anya Patel: Thanks — I'll compile the bundle and request a week extension in writing. cc: legal for attestation wording.
Maria Chen: Great, once I have the signed attestation and the export link I'll publish the CAIQ answers and mark this as escalated.
Jamal Ortiz: Will follow up with a short timeline + mitigation steps after rollback completes.
Sean Blake: I'll also include HSM rotation certs and logs (signed) in the export.
Maria Chen: Appreciated. I'll update the ticket FT-9876 and inform the customer that we're assembling the evidence and will deliver a bundle within the adjusted timeline. :white_check_mark:
